text:
alex: New tenant (Polaris) onboarding — we need capacity reserved in two regions. Account: 123456789012. Requesting increases for p5 (4x), p4d (2x), g5 (8x) across eu-west-1 and me-south-1. Also need ENI/network limits raised (target 60 ENIs per subnet to avoid placement failures). Target provision date: next Tue. Any objections or additional info I should provide?

maria: Which AZ spread do you want? Are these for inference-only or training (affects instance type mix + placement group needs). Also do we need dedicated capacity (reserved) or just quota increases?

alex: Inference-only. Prefer spread across 2 AZs per region for redundancy. For now we want quota increases so we can spin up autoscaled pools; may request reserved capacity later if run stable.

deepak: OK. A few quick checks: is 123456789012 a member account under Redwood org or a standalone? If member, AWS support sometimes needs master account details for ENI limits. Also confirm if the account already has any p4d/p5/g5 quotas in those regions (you can check with CLI).

deepak: Run this to list current EC2 quotas:
```
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --profile prod-account-123456789012
```
Replace quota-code depending on instance family. If you want I can run from my admin laptop.

sam: I can open the AWS support case and escalate to our TAM once we have exact counts + confirmation about master/member. Also need cost center (billing tag) and a JIRA ticket for approval.

alex: Account is a member account under org-root. Billing tag / cost center: team-polaris. JIRA: INFRA-4812. AZ spread: two AZs each region. If AWS pushes back on p5 in me-south-1 we can fallback to extra g5s temporarily.

maria: Noted. For inference, g5s are much cheaper per token but p5 gives latency headroom for larger models. If budget is tight, recommend prioritizing p5 in eu-west-1 and use g5s in me-south-1 as a stopgap.

deepak: Draft support case template below — copy/paste into AWS support console: 

Subject: Increase EC2 instance quotas (p5, p4d, g5) + ENI limits for account 123456789012 in eu-west-1 and me-south-1

Body:
Account ID: 123456789012
Organization master account: 210987654321
Requested increases:
- eu-west-1: Running On-Demand p5 instances -> 4 (current X -> 4)
- eu-west-1: Running On-Demand p4d instances -> 2
- eu-west-1: Running On-Demand g5 instances -> 8
- me-south-1: Running On-Demand p5 instances -> 4
- me-south-1: Running On-Demand p4d instances -> 2
- me-south-1: Running On-Demand g5 instances -> 8
- Network: Increase Elastic Network Interfaces per subnet/vpc to 60 to support ENI-heavy placements

Use case: production inference fleet for Redwood customer 'Polaris' — latency-sensitive low-batch inference across AZs. We are a member account under Redwood org and can provide organization approval if required. Please escalate to EC2 quota team and our TAM for faster processing.

Additional notes: If there are placement group constraints for p4d/p5, please advise on recommended AZs or alternate instance families.

Link to internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/aws-quota

If we get auto-response, ping me and I will escalate.

sam: Filing case now. Need the org-master ID to include — deepak, can you confirm: 210987654321 is the org master?

deepak: Yes that's the master. Also attach the cost approval doc from INFRA-4812 to the case to speed review.

quota-bot: AWS Support case opened: 987654321 — "Increase EC2 instance quotas (p5/p4d/g5) + ENI limits for account 123456789012". Status: submitted. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=987654321

irene: Updated the capacity tracker (sheet) with the requested numbers and tentative dates. Budget owner approved on paper; we still need formal charge code in the cost center.

sam: I'll follow up with the TAM and request soft-reservation guidance. If AWS offers immediate quota approvals, we'll kick off a small smoke launch to validate network plumbing. cc @maria

alex: Thanks everyone — much appreciated. If AWS rejects or asks for justification, please ping me immediately. We may temporarily shift more load to g5s if p5 counts are delayed. :thumbsup:

maria: Got it. Monitoring the case and will post updates here. If case stalls beyond 48h I'll escalate through TAM and sales engineering.
